caption: The drawing features a detailed, monochrome depiction of a decorative bowl rendered in shades of gray and black on a beige background. At the top center, the bowl is shown from a slightly elevated angle to reveal both its inner and upper edge details. The bowl has a scalloped rim and is decorated with a repeating pattern of large, teardrop-shaped motifs encircled by dots and surrounded by chevron or feather-like lines radiating toward the bowl's base. Below the bowl, there is a smaller, frontal drawing labeled "PATTERN" that isolates one teardrop motif and the radiating lines for clarity. To the right, a vertical half-section labeled "SECTION" provides a view of the bowl's shape and the central starburst pattern at the bottom. The words "ACTUAL SIZE" appear beneath the main bowl drawing, and the word "ELVIS" is written in the lower left corner of the page. The overall composition is technical and precise, focusing on the bowl’s ornamental features and construction.
title: Bowl
